entities.name: T3412 extended value
entities.description: An information element that the network may include to provide the UE with a longer periodic tracking area update timer value.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that may include the T3412 extended value IE in messages.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The user equipment that receives the T3412 extended value IE from the network.

entities.name: T3412 timer
entities.description: Periodic tracking area update timer that can be extended using the T3412 extended value IE.

relations.description: Network may include the T3412 extended value IE in messages to the UE.
T3412 extended value IE provides a longer timer value for the periodic tracking area update timer T3412.
UE receives the T3412 extended value IE from the network.
